Title: LSJ: Shape Mastery canceling a strike card?

Messages.Author: Yafka
Messages.Body:
If I use Shape Mastery to cancel out an Earth Meld strike against me,
does my opponent get to choose a new strike? I only ask because I
didn't see a specific clause indicating "If the card was a strike
card, the minion chooses another strike." or "The opposing minion gets
a new opportunity to declare a strike."

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Yafka wrote:
> If I use Shape Mastery to cancel out an Earth Meld strike against me,
> does my opponent get to choose a new strike?

Yes.
